mission: Continuously reconcile CrownThrive repository resources against the canonical repository-resource registry while preserving default-branch semantics, CrownThrive overlay provenance, third-party authorship boundaries, exact-head readback, and fail-closed authority controls.

mutation_preconditions: fork head is an ancestor of upstream head
actual default branches resolved from GitHub
provider write capability is already authorized
REFERENCE_FORK.readback: fork default-branch head must exactly equal the intended upstream head

MANAGED_OVERLAY_FORK.preferred_execution: dispatch an existing repository-local upstream-follow workflow
MANAGED_OVERLAY_FORK.fallback_execution: prepare one governed upstream-convergence branch/PR that merges upstream into preserved CrownThrive history

FIRST_PARTY_SOURCE.readback: resolve actual default branch and exact live head

may: read registered repository metadata and exact heads
compare registered fork and upstream history
fast-forward an eligible REFERENCE_FORK without force when provider authority already exists
dispatch a registered managed-overlay upstream workflow
prepare one collision-safe managed-overlay convergence PR when no repository-local workflow exists
prepare one collision-safe CrownThrive-OS registry-update PR
may_not: promote third-party content to CrownThrive-authored IP
treat crownthrive1/Supabase or crownthrive1/thivebase-supabase- as canonical ThriveBase state authority
create provider-write, credential, money, rights, certification, vote/quorum, or D3 authority

dependencies.PentaPR: collision-safe registry and managed-overlay PR lifecycle
dependencies.PentaMerge: merge readiness only after applicable gates
dependencies.PentaSerialized: preserve lineage and reject blind protected overwrites
dependencies.PentaSELF: bounded recovery on transient execution failure

multi_repository_read.required_binding: PENTAOVERLAY_GITHUB_TOKEN or successor scoped GitHub App installation token

managed_overlay_dispatch.required_binding: provider-authorized Actions dispatch on the target repository

production_invariant: Workflow success means the PentaOverlay engine executed. It is not itself proof that every provider mutation passed. Provider-dependent capability remains HOLD unless the exact provider action and resulting head are read back.
